name: ClearVolume
label: Clear Subvolume
description: Set every voxel inside a box to a fill value, keeping the volume's shape. The complement of Crop: drag the box in the 3D view over the region to clear.

parameters.name: XRANGE
parameters.label: X Range
parameters.description: Start (inclusive) and end (exclusive) voxel indices along X.

parameters.name: YRANGE
parameters.label: Y Range
parameters.description: Start (inclusive) and end (exclusive) voxel indices along Y.

parameters.name: ZRANGE
parameters.label: Z Range
parameters.description: Start (inclusive) and end (exclusive) voxel indices along Z.

parameters.name: fill_value
parameters.label: Fill Value
parameters.description: Value written to every voxel inside the box.
